Against the backdrop of the Cocoa Beach oceanfront, the U.S. Navy Blue Angel will soar through the sky to commemorate America’s 250th birthday in a powerful celebration of flight, freedom, and patriotism! Witness breathtaking aerobatic performances, military jet demonstrations, and high-flying stunts over the stunning coastline. Bring the whole family for an unforgettable weekend of aviation excitement right on the beach!
